english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a rolled-up object such as paper, cloth, wool, or a bundle.

examples.english: Don't get this roll of paper wet.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gyun2 zi2 m4 hou2 zing2 sap1

boxes.meaning: volume or section of a book

english.note: Use this for a major division of a long work, especially a book of the Bible or another classical or formal work.

examples.english: The second volume of this history book mainly covers the Qin dynasty.
examples.traditional: 呢本歷史書嘅第二卷主要講秦朝。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bun2 lik6 si2 syu1 ge3 dai6 ji6 gyun2 zyu2 jiu3 gong2 ceon4 ciu4
